Result.label: Network Analysis Summary
Result.Data: "The network analysis object displays the relationships between data item values as a series of linked nodes. The graph is a single connected cluster (a connected group of three or more nodes). There are 215 nodes and 4.5K links, where the average degree (links per node) is 42. Brown, Clarke and Martinez has the highest degree centrality score of 104 (total number of links). The network density is 9.8%. A network density of 100% means every node is directly connected to each other."
